'''2007 Kashyyyk Regionals''' was a Players Committee regional, 2007, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Premiere - Original VS12]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2007 Kashyyyk Regionals.pdf]]). The scan is a fax; headers and page bottoms are cut off on many sheets.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 2007
* '''Winner:''' —
